## ITEM 01 — [LEGISLATION]
**Headline:** SAVE America Act passes House; Trump issues legislative ultimatum
**Claimant:** President Donald J. Trump / Congressional Republicans
**Source:** [The White House](https://www.whitehouse.gov/articles/2026/03/the-save-america-act-is-the-most-popular-election-reform-in-decades/) | Bias: Right (official government source)
**Documentation:** [H.R. legislative text via Congress.gov](https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/4894/text) — primary legislation available. Trump statement on Truth Social cited by multiple outlets.
**Coverage spread:** Covered across the spectrum — White House (right), Al Jazeera (center-left), Brennan Center (left), Center for American Progress (left), NAACP LDF (left)
**Coverage gap:** Critical coverage concentrated on left-leaning outlets; right-leaning coverage largely framing as popular reform
**Documentation quality:** STRONG (bill text available, White House statements on record)
**Notes:** The SAVE America Act is a rebranded expansion of the SAVE Act (H.R. 22), which passed the House in April 2025 but stalled in the Senate. The new version adds criminal penalties for election officials who register voters without required documentation. Trump declared he would not sign other legislation until this bill passes. Critics, including the NAACP LDF and Center for American Progress, argue it constitutes voter suppression targeting Black voters, young voters, and rural Americans. Supporters cite an 83% Pew poll favoring voter ID. The Heritage Foundation's own fraud database documents only 100 confirmed noncitizen voter fraud cases since 2000, out of 1.5 billion ballots cast.
